In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the groupoid of transformations of the rigid structure of the surface is the fundamental groupoid of the space of all Riemann surfaces.
the groupoid of transformations of a rigid structure is a 2-groupoid with a finite presentation, and a topological quantum field theories is a representation of this groupoid.
the 2-category of transformations of rigid structure on surfaces is the universal 2-category of topological quantum field theories.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a new perspective on topological quantum field theories and the 2-group of transformations of rigid surfaces.
we have given a new proof of the Moore-Seiberg conjecture, and have shown that the conjecture is a special case of a general theorem on representations of 2-groupoids.
we have found a 2-groupoid that is the universal object for the data of a topological quantum field theories with a finite number of objects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2-category of rigid structures on a surface has a finite presentation and that the 2-groups that act on this 2-category are finite.
the groupoid of rigid structures is the right object to study when one wants to understand the 2-group of topological quantum field theories.
the theory of rigid surfaces provides a new way to think about topological quantum field theories.
